IL_6828: ldstr          {=tDK8b1J8}You vaguely recall hearing that lead might be poisonous, but you'll try the others.
IL_68bf: ldstr          {=MfbK2Sqa}Tell your man to save his ingenuity for battle, not trade.
IL_68f4: ldstr          {=a5gLRsa4}Thank your man bruskly and try his trick, but pay him nothing.

IL_6980: ldstr          {=a939QfLJ}As you leave {TOWN_NAME}, a young woman throws herself in front of your horse. She raises her face to the sky, tears at her hair, and wails that her young husband signed up to fight for you and was slain in battle. "You took him from me!" she screams. It is not clear what she wants.

IL_69b0: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)

IL_69b6: ldstr          {=8uabQDxp}Tell her, as soberly as you can, that her husband gave his life for a noble cause. Hand her a purse of 100 denars, and tell her that you are sure that he would be happy if she marries again, as long as he remains in her memory.

IL_6a04: ldstr          {=kZJvgtE3}Dismount, burst into tears, take her hands in yours and tell her that every life lost in your service tears at your heart, and that you want nothing more but for these wars to end.
IL_6a3d: ldstr          {=52l7VuWI}Tell her that Heaven expects her to bear her fate with dignity.
IL_6a60: ldstr          {=Sz28bZOI}Have your purser speak to her at length about what she might need, as you keep your distance.

IL_6ab1: ldstr          {=PqzLYt6i}Some time recently - you're not sure exactly when - your men started a new post-battle tradition - going about the field collecting grisly trophies from slain enemies. Now you can't help noticing these prizes dangling from their belts or the halters of their horses.

IL_6ae2: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_6ae8: ldstr          {=1zsWhG2N}Tell your men as best you can that, while you respect their spirit, this will frighten local farmers who don't understand warriors' ways.
IL_6b2e: ldstr          {=VHlwd8na}Take a lively interest in each of these ornaments, asking your men at which battle and from which fallen foe they were taken.
IL_6bbe: ldstr          {=xoH5LaY0}Harangue your men for their barbarism, tell them to honor rather than mock their fallen foes.

IL_6c59: ldstr          {=YAnTtrLs}Your reputation as a skilled trader generally does you good, but there is always a downside. When you arrive in {TOWN}, the market inspector descends from his tower to present you with a list of fees that you supposedly accumulated over the years, based on decrees that go back several centuries. The decrees may be genuine, but in all your talk with merchants, you never heard of anyone ever paying them.

IL_6c8e: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_6c94: ldstr          {=RPyFwR6I}Erupt in fury, telling the inspector that there is no way you will be fleeced in this way, legally or illegally.
IL_6d09: ldstr          {=vzA2ZJog}Pay, but say for all to hear that selective application of obscure laws is little better than theft.
IL_6d57: ldstr          {=ogP9E5Hx}Reason with the inspector over a splendid dinner and an amphora of the finest wine that is of course on you.
IL_6db4: ldstr          {=9aYLFpC9}Just hand over the money to make the problem go away.

IL_6e0c: ldstr          {=XQU3Tobe}Knowing your reputation as a trader, two merchants in {TOWN_NAME} are asking you to arbitrate a dispute between them. The two had drawn up a contract wherein each partner had a half-share in an incoming shipment of wine. When it arrived, however, the sea captain demanded twice the price. The wealthier of the two partners was at the docks. He took the initiative and purchased the goods, deciding to take a loss for the sake of his reputation as a reliable supplier to the local taverns, but the second is poorer and wants out of the deal.

IL_6e41: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_6e47: ldstr          {=nbshAaHo}The letter of the contract would favor the wealthier partner. Merchants should be careful what they sign.
IL_6e8d: ldstr          {=bsC5zEoI}Never mind the letter of the contract, the reasonable, decent move for the richer merchant would have been to consult with his partner.
IL_6ed3: ldstr          {=Ib04QQJY}Tell them that the whole thing gives you a headache.
IL_6ee4: ldstr          {=0ZP5fDBX}Let the wealthier merchant know that your decision is for sale.

IL_6f3f: ldstr          {=fhjyEgld}Your troops are taking a bit longer than usual to get ready, and you've had time to relax a bit and watch goings-on at the market. One commodity vendor in particular has caught your attention. He always uses one set of weights for the sacks that he is buying from local farmers, and another for goods that he sells. You have little doubt that one or both of these sets is a false measure, allowing him to defraud his customers.

IL_6f70: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)

IL_6fe1: ldstr          {=MGfXReQC}Walk up to the merchant, and insist he use the lighter weights to sell you one measure of his goods. Then come back later and return them, insisting he use the heavier weights.

IL_704e: ldstr          {=1jAyaivZ}As you pass through the village streets, a dog dashes out from among some spectators and bites at the heels of one of your {CAVALRYMAN}'s horses, panicking it. IL_710e: ldstr          {=te1A19Xe}Tell your {CAVALRYMAN} that he can sort it out.

IL_7147: ldstr          {=EbNZg7jp}In hot climes, often the most vulnerable part of a fortress is its water supply. Most depend on wells but those can run dry. After days spent in front of {FORTRESS_NAME}, you've caught glimpses of the defenders slipping into the hills. You explore where they've gone, and eventually you come across a rudimentary cistern. You suspect that they must be refreshing their water here.

IL_717c: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_7182: ldstr          {=57VuY9ln}Poison it! Some women and children of {FORTRESS_NAME} may well perish along with the defenders, but such is war.

IL_723a: ldstr          {=bGaD3LoG}The best blows are struck not to the body but to the spirit. Let the defenders know you found it by diverting it to a pool where your men can bathe on the hottest, thirstiest days of the siege.
IL_7299: ldstr          {=iiwhVNBb}You respect the defenders' cunning. Simply observe how they slip out of the fortress, by ropes or hidden gates, and learn from it.

IL_72ca: ldstr          {=0DSopB7F}After observing the terrain around {FORTRESS_NAME}, you think conditions might be appropriate for mining - digging a tunnel under a wall, then collapsing it. This can open a breach but is time-consuming and risky. If you encounter rock underground, you may find all your efforts go to waste. If the ground is too soft, the tunnel may collapse and bury your men. Most troops are reluctant to spend time in dark, confined tunnels unless they are paid extra, or forced.

It's hard to hit with your catapults and the ground is too rocky to mine, but you reckon troops with pickaxes by themselves could bring it down - assuming they were willing to brave the storm of arrows and rocks that would no doubt come pouring from the battlements above.

IL_769f: ldstr          {=wJ3Nh230}A breach is not worth the losses.

IL_7a45: ldstr          {=guEjfYhO}One of your {TROOP_NAME} had some drinks with the arena master in {TOWN} and left the tavern with a job offer - work as a trainer and occasional combatant. IL_7a62: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)

IL_7ae9: ldstr          {=klVc5afL}Let him go if he splits his signing bonus with you.

IL_7b69: ldstr          {=GgYzaakh}Trade in {TOWN_NAME} has been booming, and prices and wages have been going up. The workers at your {WORKSHOP} have taken notice. Your superviser reports that they have all refused to come in to work until they receive a pay increase. He notes that there remain plenty of hungry mouths and willing hands in town, but that the current workers might cause trouble if they are replaced.

IL_7b8b: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)

IL_7c13: ldstr          {=aTU2CgIU}Fire the lot of them, hire different workers, and post some troops outside to protect your shop.

IL_7c9c: ldstr          {=Eih6lrcN}Business is good at your {WORKSHOP} in {TOWN}, but in the rush to keep up with demand the normal precautions are not being taken. {INJURY_TEXT} He will live, but is unlikely to be able to do skilled work, and the rest of the workers are worried about future accidents.

IL_7cbe: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_7cc4: ldstr          {=JdlbkM8C}Pay him a pension and order your supervisors to take more care, even if it slows down production.
IL_7d40: ldstr          {=OlvD0u1O}You're not going to pay for another man's clumsiness. Let work recommence at the same pace.
IL_7d8f: ldstr          {=k4aNfNHg}As on the battlefield, so on the workshop floor. Let each team work at its own pace, receiving bonuses for output, but also taking responsibiliy for injuries.

IL_7dee: ldstr          {=82Fno8Vr}Your clerk at your {WORKSHOP} in {TOWN} has caught one of your foremen skimming from the funds you use to purchase raw materials. Luckily, he did not take much, and he readily confessed. How do you prevent this from happening in the future?

IL_7e10: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)

IL_7e16: ldstr          {=47hUs9yg}You make an example of the foreman. You hand him over to the town authorities and encourage them to apply the full penalty - branding as a thief and exile from the town.
IL_7e72: ldstr          {=n2mOvIPt}You appeal to your men's better natures. You plea for leniency for your foreman, and beg them not to take advantage.
IL_7eb2: ldstr          {=cyZG4qHm}You institute a complex scheme of bookkeeping, even though it will make purchases more onerous and slow down production.
IL_7ef1: ldstr          {=G8eaX10B}You treat all your workers as potential thieves, having them searched coming and going from the workshop.

IL_7f1f: ldstr          {=cJdoDJ4M}One prominent resident of {TOWN}, {ARTISAN_NAME}, approaches you. Your {WORKSHOP} has been hiring workers who have recently migrated in from the countryside. If you refuse, he won't be responsible if the carts carrying your shipments get swarmed by traffic going through tight gates, slowing down production.

IL_7f41: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_7f47: ldstr          {=bdUzdzIe}Sadly bid farewell to the migrants and wish them well in future endeavors.
IL_7f84: ldstr          {=qoSObD62}Tell {ARTISAN_NAME} to do his worst - you're not firing men who've served you well.
IL_7fce: ldstr          {=TbF5Kc4x}Ask {ARTISAN_NAME} if you can make a sizeable contribution to his guild's feast and funeral fund.

IL_805c: ldstr          {=pNVKWAKo}Throughout your visit to {VILLAGE}, one of your older {TROOP_TYPE} seems moody and downcast. As you march out, he suddenly stops, stares at a roadside stall, then breaks ranks from your party and starts shouting at the vendor. The story quickly comes tumbling out. He served in one of the Empire's old legions in a battle here against the {NEAREST_OTHER_CULTURE}, and the vendor is selling scraps of metal that were clearly looted from the graves of the dead.

IL_8079: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)

IL_80d8: ldstr          {=fqBRonK9}Do you not also not loot whatever you can from the dead at your victories? Tell your man to save his anger for wrongs done to the living.
IL_810d: ldstr          {=WGmKib15}Erupt in fury at the vendor and accuse him of grave desecration. It's unlikely that the thefts will stop, but your men will be pleased.

IL_8189: ldstr          {=Jo5OjwAU}Your men fought truly heroically in the last battle. As they help their wounded comrades back to camp and gather the slain, their weary faces sometimes look to you with expectation. If ever there was a time to give them some extra recognition of their valor and sacrifice, this would be it.

IL_81ba: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_81c0: ldstr          {=Wenvx1OE}Reach into your treasury and grab great fistfuls of silver denars, hurling it to your men and praising them by name for their deeds.

IL_8280: ldstr          {=WnlD7awi}Gruffly tell them that you were pleased they did their duty.

IL_82ae: ldstr          {=D7ZcX8XR}As you pass through the market, {NOTABLE.NAME} requests a minute of your time. {?NOTABLE.GENDER}Her{?}His{\?} cousin is planning on doing some business in {TOWN}, and {?NOTABLE.GENDER}she{?}he{\?} would like a letter of reference from you. You know next to nothing about the lad, although {NOTABLE.NAME} swears that he is honest and conscientious. You find you are receiving a number of these types of requests as your fame spreads.

IL_82cc: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_82d2: ldstr          {=z15Ux7sh}Write truthfully that you don't know much about the bearer of the letter, but he comes from good family.
IL_82f6: ldstr          {=aZwaFhA6}Write effusively about the lad's qualities.
IL_8345: ldstr          {=8rEX8rjv}Tell {NOTABLE.NAME} that you will write whatever {?NOTABLE.GENDER}she{?}he{\?} wants, for the proper price.
IL_839d: ldstr          {=DOPdMPla}Upbraid {NOTABLE.NAME} in the street for all to hear for daring to presume that you would recommend anyone that you do not know.
IL_83ff: ldstr          {=OqlihYNW}The Tiller and the Wanderer

IL_8404: ldstr          {=nuqL3OAF}As you are leaving your fief you stumble across an altercation. A group of nomads, who pass by annually on their migration from summer to winter pastures, have allowed their herds to graze in your tenants' crops. Your troops far outnumber the nomads and your tenants are urging you to teach them a lesson, but of course their kin might retaliate at a later date.

IL_8435: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_843b: ldstr          {=fI8Bd468}Seize the nomads' herds to compensate you and your tenants for their crops.
IL_8566: ldstr          {=ciQPfxEC}Demand that the nomads pay fair compensation for damaged crops, even though you know this will not settle the problem for long.
IL_85e1: ldstr          {=fkQj3TIP}Tell the nomads that proud warriors such as themselves need not worry what these dirt-diggers think. Share a meal with them, and see if some will join you.

IL_8695: ldstr          {=SAXnFQLq}The people of {VILLAGE_NAME} warned you to take care outside their village. When the mist gathers, The woods will be haunted by spirits whose shriek foretells death. Now the gloom is gathering, and you hear mutterings from your men. You are certain that they will soon be hearing wailing and seeing apparitions, real or imagined. The horses are becoming twitchy too, picking up on the mood of the men, and accidents are likely to happen.

IL_86c6: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_86cc: ldstr          {=uD05twgi}Tell your men to ignore the superstitions of villagers, and press on.
IL_8765: ldstr          {=BxpJKMYq}Dispel the spirits in the approved orthodox Calradian way, by loudly calling on Heaven to ward off the ghosts of Below.
IL_879a: ldstr          {=4Ef7xG1o}Propitiate the spirits as the villagers advised, by slaughtering a black cockerel that they sold one of your men.

IL_87da: ldstr          {=D9T64ejr}As you leave {VILLAGE_NAME}, several of the villagers approach you. They warn you that stagnant ponds from the last rain have yet to fully dry and have bred mosquitos. They offer to sell you a concoction of oils including rosemary, catmint and other herbs that they say will ward off all flying vermin.

IL_880a: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_8810: ldstr          {=zGVNqFnh}Buy vials of ointment for every member of your party, at the risk of looking gullible.
IL_8870: ldstr          {=qCoqaa70}Have your men wrap themselves up as best they can and press on.
IL_8893: ldstr          {=VccCV5dX}Take circuitous routs to avoid the ponds.

IL_88cc: ldstr          {=WR7NCetE}As you leave {VILLAGE_NAME}, a scraggly young man waves to attract your attention. He leads a magnificent {RARE_HORSE}, and says that he will sell it to you for a mere 500 denars. He claims he found it wandering on a heath, almost dead from exhaustion and neglect, and he nursed it back to health. He won't go into town because he says he would be unfairly accused of theft.

IL_88e9: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_88ef: ldstr          {=YVETzHXK}Plausible enough, and you have no time to check the provenance of every bargain you find. Buy the horse!
IL_8973: ldstr          {=B9HD9PNw}A likely story... Place the man under arrest and send word to the authorities of {TOWN_NAME}, who have the time to sort things out.
IL_89d2: ldstr          {=CyM5bAdB}You're not sure you trust the seller, but you're not handing over to officials who might just hang him and seize the horse themselves. Go on your way.
IL_89f5: ldstr          {=AwBJzppu}Take the horse without paying. Tell the seller that thieves have no right to complain of theft.

IL_8a6b: ldstr          {=th5MgyAZ}As you enter {TOWN_NAME}, one of your {ASERAI_TROOPS} approaches you. Many of his comrades are not used to the heat of the desert, he says. They march after drinking wine through the evening but are not careful to properly take water throughout the day, as the sun beats down on them. He has seen men collapse and die from such carelessness and ignorance.

IL_8a8c: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_8a92: ldstr          {=lbSsRg8w}Your men will resent any curbs on their celebrations, even for their own health. Warn them but take no other precautions.
IL_8ac6: ldstr          {=3Uub2e17}Tell your men that there shall be no wine tonight, and none henceforth until they learn how to handle themselves in the desert.
IL_8ae9: ldstr          {=cG9pkbqo}Let them men celebrate, but move slowly in the morning, pausing to make sure that each man is drinking from his water-skin.

{=0cMibkQO}You may know me as a {?PLAYER.GENDER}woman{?}man{\?} of honor.
{=2P9mMbrq}It is not in my interest to change sides. (Self-interest persuasion failed.)
{=4HWFvX8M}I gave an oath to my liege. To break it, even for a good reason, would be a great stain on my honor.
{=5E2bIcGb}I will not betray my liege. (Loyalty persuasion failed.)
{=5lq4HNU5}{CURRENT_LIEGE.NAME} is not known for keeping his word.
{=6lbjddM8}{PRIOR_LINE} We have been together in many wars. Including many against your {?IS_SAME_CULTURE}people{?}allies{\?}, the {ETHNIC_TERM}, I should add.
{=7QdKwOhY}Fortune favors the bold. With you with us, we will win this war quickly.
{=8wUfQc4W}You know me. I'll be careful not to get this get back to the wrong ears.
{=9cZeHcAC}The cruelty of {CURRENT_LIEGE.NAME} is legendary. Who cares what he stands for if the realm is drenched in blood?
{=A6E74QyR}You are badly outnumbered. A rebellion should at least have a chance of success.
{=CymOFgzv}I gave an oath to {CURRENT_LIEGE.LINK} - but {?CURRENT_LIEGE.GENDER}her{?}his{\?} disregard for the common people of this realm does give me pause.
{=EYQI9HJv}I gave an oath to {CURRENT_LIEGE.LINK} - but {?CURRENT_LIEGE.GENDER}her{?}his{\?} disregard for the laws of this realm does give me pause.
{=GEBRuVcZ}Why change sides now? Once one declares oneself a rebel, there is usually no going back.
{=GlRZN1J5}I gave an oath to {CURRENT_LIEGE.LINK} - though no oath binds me to serve a weak leader who is too softhearted to rule.
{=GtIpsut6}I don't even like you. You expect me to discuss something like this with you?
{=HM7auUMA}You are my friend, but even so, this is a risky conversation to have.
{=I5f6Xg3a}You must have heard of my deeds. I speak to you as one warrior to another.
{=ITqVF9i4}You know {CURRENT_LIEGE.NAME} asks you to do dishonorable things, and no oath binds you to doing evil.
{=IoaAvgRD}You know {NEW_LIEGE.LINK} have had our differences. You expect me to change sides for him?
{=IpnQP7A1}Better to die fighting for a just ruler than to live under an unjust one.
{=KbQQV5rI}My oath is my oath. I cannot break it. (Oath persuasion failed.)
{=LtDqAAk4}I consider {CURRENT_LIEGE.LINK} to be an upright ruler. {NEW_LIEGE.LINK} is not.
{=OdS0e6Sb}{NEW_LIEGE.NAME} stands up for what you believe in, while {CURRENT_LIEGE.NAME} does not.
{=Owa28Kpr}I barely know you, and you're asking me to talk treason?
{=PGkFvo77}{CURRENT_LIEGE.LINK} is a friend of mine. I cannot imagine betraying {?CURRENT_LIEGE.GENDER}her{?}him{\?}.
{=PtWQ789Z}I'm not sure I trust you people.
{=QY55NgWl}I gave an oath to {CURRENT_LIEGE.LINK} - though I'm not sure he's always kept his oath to me.
{=VA8BTMBR}You must know of my reputation. You know that it's not in my interest to betray your trust.
{=VJoCtAvz}I gave an oath to my liege.
{=VnECJbmq}That is not enough.
{=XFzbzt3W}You are known for your valor. Fortune favors the bold. Together, we will win this war quickly.
{=Xlb7Xxyl}{CURRENT_LIEGE.LINK} stands for what I believe in.
{=ZQa7tXdK}You are somewhat outnumbered. Even if I agree with you, it would be wise of me to wait.
{=ZzR9VTU0}{CURRENT_LIEGE.NAME} isn't known for his sense of loyalty. Why do you feel so much to him?
{=a37zTVVe}Believe me, I'll be generous to those who came to me early. Perhaps not as generous to those who came late.
{=aMICdOjq}{NEW_LIEGE.NAME} will be grateful to those who backed {?NEW_LIEGE.GENDER}her{?}him{\?} before {?NEW_LIEGE.GENDER}her{?}his{\?} victory was assured. Not so much after it's assured.
{=abkmGhLH}Has {CURRENT_LIEGE.NAME} really repaid you for your service as you deserve?
{=arBQHbWv}I'm not sure I know you well enough to discuss something like this.
{=awaFsZ5l}I have always stood by {CURRENT_LIEGE.LINK}. Whether {CURRENT_LIEGE.LINK} has stood by me or not is another question...
{=ch6zCk2w}You know me as someone who seeks to avoid bloodshed.
{=dGkJi1yb}I have a strategy to win. And my strategies always work, eventually.
{=lhnuawq3}You know very well that in politics oaths are easily made, and just as easily broken.
{=nQStXojH}If {?CURRENT_LIEGE.GENDER}she{?}he{\?} ever violated {?CURRENT_LIEGE.GENDER}her{?}his{\?} oath to you, it absolves you of your duty to {?CURRENT_LIEGE.GENDER}her{?}him{\?}.
{=p2rTaKo8}You have no claim to the throne. Even in the unlikely case that others follow you, another usurper will just rise up to defeat you.
{=qsnh0KGS}As your friend, I give you my word that I won't breathe a word to anyone else about this conversation.
{=ttpan5jp}{CURRENT_LIEGE.LINK} and I have been through a great deal together.
{=u3eGQRn8}I am not entirely comfortable discussing this with you.
{=wOKF17ta}I gave an oath to {CURRENT_LIEGE.LINK} - though no oath binds me to serve a weak leader who'll take us all down.
{=y3xguaCc}Put your interests and the good of the realm first. There's too much at stake for that.
{=yZWBDAG0}You are known as a {?LORD.GENDER}woman{?}man{\?} of honor. You may know me as one as well.
{=yxeyl4LW}I am simply not comfortable discussing this with you.
{=z5cLVzC8}It's well known that you and {CURRENT_LIEGE.NAME} loathe each other.

IL_0b48: ldstr          {=XFzbzt3W}You are known for your valor. Fortune favors the bold. Together, we will win this war quickly.

{=3skTM1DC}Most people would put a knife in your back for a few coppers. Have a few friends and keep them close, I guess.
{=5Vk6I1sf}Between your followers, your rivals and your enemies, you must have met a lot of interesting people...
{=6L1b1nJa}Oh I have a long list of scores to settle. You can be sure of that.
{=6kjacaiB}I hope I can bring peace to the land, and justice, and alleviate people's suffering.
{=8BnWa83o}I'm just honored to have fought alongside comrades who thought nothing of shedding their blood to keep me alive.
{=8hEVO9hw}Hmm. Perhaps you and I have different priorities in life.
{=HAtHptbV}In the end, I don't think we have that much in common.
{=Ns315pxY}Perhaps we are not meant for each other.
{=PoDVgQaz}Well, it would take a bit long to discuss this.
{=QHG6LU1g}Ah yes, I've seen cruelty, degradation and degeneracy like you wouldn't believe. Fascinating stuff, all of it.
{=YNBm3LkC}I feel lucky to live in a time where a valiant warrior can make a name for {?PLAYER.GENDER}herself{?}himself{\?}.
{=ZmxbIXsp}I am sorry you feel that way. We can speak later.
{=bwWdGLDv}I have seen great good and great evil, but I can only hope the good outweights the evil in most people's hearts.
{=dY2PzpIV}I'm not sure how much we have in common..
{=ggKa4Bd8}Hmm... First thing to do after taking power is to work on your plan to remain in power.
{=ja5bAOMr}The world's a dungheap, basically. The sooner I earn enough to retire, the better.
{=lDJUL4lZ}I think we maybe see the world a bit differently.
{=rfyalLyY}What can I say? It's a beautiful world, but filled with so much suffering.
{=rrqCZa0H}I'll make sure those who stuck their necks out for me, who sweated and bled for me, get their due.
{=rtqD9cnu}Yeah, it's a rough world, but there are lots of opportunities to be seized right now if you're not afraid to get your hands a bit dirty.

{=2LrFafpB}And I will respect and cherish your family.
{=3IBVEOwh}I still think we may not be ready yet.
{=3cw5pRFM}I had not thought that I might marry a shieldmaiden. But it is intriguing. Tell me, have you killed men in battle?
{=44tA6fNa}I will try to earn your family's trust, then.
{=563qB3ar}I can only hope that if they come to know my loyalty, they will accept me.
{=6LfkfJiJ}Can't your passion for me overcome such base feelings?
{=8a13MGzr}All I can say is that I try to repay good with good, and evil with evil.
{=9qoLQva5}Whatever oath I give to you, you may be sure that I will keep it.
{=BaifRgT5}That's useful to know for when it comes time to discuss the exchange of dowries.
{=DLc6NfiV}I shall win you the riches you deserve, or die in the attempt.
{=DR2aK4aQ}I respect our ancient laws and traditions. I don't want to find myself at odds with you.
{=E9s2bjqw}I can only hope that some day you could change your mind.
{=EkkNQb5N}I like a warrior who strikes fear in the hearts of his enemies. Are you that kind of man?
{=FEmiPPbO}Perhaps you've heard the stories about me, then. They're all true.
{=HFkXIyCV}My family likes you...
{=LEsuGM8a}Let no one - not even your family - come between us!
{=LN7SGvnS}Love is but an infatuation. Judge me by my character.
{=LTUEFTaF}I hope that I am known as someone who understands the value of loyalty.
{=LjiYq9cH}I am sorry. I am not sure that I could ever love you.
{=Oe5Tf7OZ}My foes may not fear my sword, but they should fear my cunning.
{=Tj8bGW4b}If a man and a woman respect each other, politics should not divide them.
{=Xa7PsIao}I am sorry. I will not marry without my family's blessing.
{=ZNfWXliN}I will be honest, my lady. You are but a common adventurer, and by marrying you I give up a chance to forge an alliance with a family of real influence and power.
{=ZbvbsA4i}I can only hope that if they come to know my virtues, they will accept me.
{=ZsGqHBlR}I need a partner whom I can trust...
{=a2dJDUoL}My sword is my dowry. The gold and land will follow.
{=b2ePtImV}Those who are loyal to me, I am loyal to them.
{=bBTHy6f9}I just don't think that we would be happy together.
{=bOQEc7jA}I am a {?PLAYER.GENDER}woman{?}man{\?} of my word. I hope that it is sufficient.
{=beK0AZ2y}I am concerned that you do not have the means to support a family.
{=c2Yrci3B}I believe that we need a strong ruler in this realm. I don't want to find myself at odds with you.
{=cOyolp4F}I am just not... How can I say this? I am not attracted to you.
{=erKuPRWA}I have a plan to rise in this world. I'm still only a little way up the ladder.
{=fAdwIqbg}I think you should try to win my family's approval.
{=faa9sFfE}I do what I can to alleviate suffering in this world. I hope that is enough.
{=hwjzKcUw}So what? This is supposed to be an alliance of our houses, not of our hearts.
{=lay7hKUK}I insist that my {?PLAYER.GENDER}wife{?}husband{\?} conduct {?PLAYER.GENDER}herself{?}himself{\?} according to the highest standards.
{=m3EkYCA6}Perhaps if you see how much I love you, you could come to love me over time.
